interactions.note: Clicking the name/logo 5 times opens the back room.
Typing 'chei' 20 times anywhere (not in a text field) turns the screen black and shows the confrontation.
Poking the avatar 7 times.

The folded page corner.

actions.text: the corner folds back. there's writing under it.

Typing 'hello' anywhere opens the guestbook.
Typing the name.

Visiting the about page three times.
Reaching depth 3.

Reaching depth 7.

Scrolling all the way down the home page.
Sitting still for a minute when deep enough.
Coming home many times.
